blindness.description: No Maxwell numerical pressure coefficient and no SST electromagnetic normalization target are used by the blind pass/fail analysis. Numerical targets are committed separately and are only read by the unblinding step.

decision_rule.FAIL: Any failed mandatory gate falsifies the tested closure within the preregistered model class.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Missing mandatory data, rank-deficient scans, or insufficient resolution prevent a verdict.
decision_rule.PASS: All mandatory blind gates pass. This supports only the tested closure class; it does not establish SST or Maxwell's historical microscopic mechanism.
